corrections.reason: The canonical Ge'ez verb in Revelation 9:6 is 'ወይትኀጣእ' (from ኀጥአ, translated immediately as 'ይታጣል'). The Fidel 'ኀ' was misread as 'ጎ'.
The printed word is 'ኮቴ' (5th order 'ቴ', meaning 'hoof' in 'የእግራቸው ኮቴ'), where the bottom vowel loop on the right leg was misread as the 3rd order 'ቲ'.

Both visually on the page (equal-length legs on the second 'ለ') and philologically in the Andemta contrast ('ርጥበት ልምላሜ ያለው ሥጋ ... ርጥበት ልምላሜ ከሌለው ቃል ጋራ'), the word is 'ከሌለው' ('which lacks'), not 'ከሌላው'.
